title: Aquarius, when they remember your fun fact
old_caption:
Aquarius, they remembered your octopus fact. Three hearts.
Someone was listening. Let that feel good.

title: Pisces, when your holiday card is three pages
old_caption:
Pisces, is your holiday card on page four yet?
Big feelings are a gift. Send it.

title: Their "ok." had a period
old_caption: A single period sent Virgo's brain into a full simulation: mad, bored, moving to the moon. It was just how they type. Who in your life texts with terrifying punctuation?

title: Seen at 9:41
old_caption: Seen at 9:41, and by 9:58 Cancer was knitting a scarf for the memory. The real reason for the silence? Pasta. What's the longest you've stared at a "Seen"?

title: One heart, not two
old_caption: Two hearts every night, then one. Libra drafted three replies, deleted all of them, and it was a slipped thumb. Be honest: do you count the hearts?

title: "Can we talk later?"
old_caption: Four words, one houseplant jury and a fully rehearsed defence. The big talk was about movie snacks. Which sign spirals hardest at "can we talk?"

title: Typing... stopped
old_caption: Nine minutes of dots appearing and vanishing. A poem? A confession? A whole novel? It was "hi". Tag the friend who types for nine minutes and sends one word.

title: They wrote "haha"
old_caption: Leo told a duck joke and got a lowercase "haha". Three rewrites later, the best friend leaked that it was SO funny. Does a short haha count? Asking for Leo.

title: The goodbye wave
old_caption: Four camera angles, slow motion and a referee review of one goodbye wave. Verdict: fine. Better than fine, actually. Which sign replays every goodbye?

title: Liked an old photo
old_caption: Sagittarius liked a photo from three years ago and started planning life as a lighthouse keeper. They just said hi back. Have you ever done the deep-scroll like?
